messages:
Nora (Docs): CI is spamming linkcheck failures after the small docs upgrade. Broken fragment: /reference/auth#rate-limiting-traffic-light
BuildBot: docs-ci | LINKCHECK FAILED
BuildBot: Broken fragment: /reference/auth -> #rate-limiting-traffic-light (404)
Nora (Docs): the heading in reference/auth.md was '## Rate limiting 🚦' — emoji slipped in during a copyedit last week
Samir (DevEx): emoji in headings -> different slug across environments. some slugifiers drop emoji, others transliterate. that explains the mismatch with older inbound links (they used #rate-limiting-traffic-light)
Ola (Eng): quick fix: add explicit id to the heading and add a short redirect rule for the known legacy fragment. tiny PR will do it.
Rex (Tech Writer): proposed heading patch:
```md
## Rate limiting 🚦 {#rate-limiting-traffic-light}
```
Rex (Tech Writer): netlify/docusaurus redirect entry example (one-off):
```text
# preserve old inbound fragment
/reference/auth#rate-limiting-traffic-light   /reference/auth#rate-limiting  301!
```
Samir (DevEx): instead of a one-off, I'd like to add a small helper in our linkcheck step to canonicalize slugs using the slugify rules we ship, and treat canonicalized == acceptable. prevents noise when we intentionally change headings.
Nora (Docs): good idea. Also let's add a note in docs/contrib/heading-style.md: "Avoid unescaped emoji in public headings; prefer explicit ids for anchors we link to externally."
Ola (Eng): I'll open PR with: 1) add explicit id to heading, 2) add redirect, 3) tweak linkcheck to canonicalize slugs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4112 (draft)
BuildBot: PR 4112 | checks started
Rex (Tech Writer): I'll scan repo for other headings containing emojis or rare punctuation and open small PRs — found 4 so far (examples, guides, and reference pages).
Samir (DevEx): follow-ups: 1) merge PR 4112, 2) deploy site, 3) run a quick audit for emoji/punctuation in headings every deploy for the next 2 weeks (warn-only).
Nora (Docs): once this lands, please ping me and I will close the CI incident. thanks all :raised_hands:
